svg.title: FoveaWAM architecture
svg.desc: Vertical FoveaWAM architecture with the same real inputs, labels and baseline as the horizontal candidate. Current RGB-D and histories form S, 16 learned tokens form M. The shared-projection 12-layer backbone has separate world/action FFNs. Training-only patch readouts predict sparse 3D displacement/visibility and visual auxiliaries; mean M predicts SE(3) and current target RGB. Ground-truth labels at 50,200,350 ms are shown, with flow arrows at 3x display scale. The directed mask is S->S, M->S,M, A->S,M,A. World K,V are cached once for five Euler action steps. Action icons and pose-glyph size are schematic.

g.text: A attends to S, M, A
